Info

Defines segregated interface IPlanStorer for trajectory plan and file writing operations.

class scarajectory.core.service.storage.iplan_storer.IPlanStorer(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Protocol for saving trajectory plan files and writing text/binary content.

It defines:

methods:
save_plan - Saves current trajectory plan to JSON file path.
save_text_file - Writes text content to file path.
save_binary_file - Writes binary byte payload to destination file path.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
save_binary_file(content: bytes, filepath: str) → None[source]¶

Writes binary byte payload to destination file path.

Parameters:

  • content – Binary raw bytes to write.

  • filepath – Destination file path.

save_plan(plan: ITrajectoryReadOnly, filepath: str) → None[source]¶

Saves current trajectory plan to JSON file path.

Parameters:

  • plan – ITrajectoryReadOnly instance to save.

  • filepath – Target JSON file path.

save_text_file(content: str, filepath: str) → None[source]¶

Writes text content to file path using UTF-8 encoding.

Parameters:

  • content – String text to write.

  • filepath – Destination file path.
